name: org.machanism.machai:gw-maven-plugin
description: GW Maven Plugin is the Maven integration for Machai Ghostwriter and Guided File Processing. It runs AI-assisted guidance and action workflows against Maven project content, including Java source, tests, Markdown documentation, site content, configuration, and other selected files. The plugin exposes aggregator goals for project-wide processing and reactor-aware per-module goals. It resolves Maven project, session, reactor, and settings context; accepts scan paths, instructions, exclusions, model selection, reusable acts, and configuration-file settings; and can obtain provider credentials from a Maven settings.xml server. For Java Maven projects it also registers classpath-aware tools that discover fully qualified class names and inspect reflective class metadata, members, annotations, source paths, class paths, and dependency coordinates. The primary workflows are guidance processing with gw:gw and explicit action processing with gw:act.

constructors.description: Creates the aggregator guidance-processing Maven mojo. Maven constructs and configures this mojo when the gw:gw goal is invoked.

examples.description: Invokes the Maven-created mojo to process guidance in the project's Markdown documentation directory.

constructors.description: Creates the action-processing Maven mojo with Maven's interactive prompt service. Maven dependency injection supplies the prompter when an act prompt must be collected interactively.

examples.description: Uses Maven to create and execute the action mojo with the named review act against Java sources.

constructors.description: Creates a project-backed class-introspection tool and initializes class discovery for the supplied Maven project.

examples.description: Creates the tool programmatically when an integration already has an org.apache.maven.project.MavenProject instance.

features.name: gw:gw
features.description: Runs the aggregator guidance workflow. It scans the selected project path for Ghostwriter guidance comments, configures a GuidanceProcessor, and can coordinate traversal of a multi-module build. This goal can run with or without a Maven project.

examples.description: Runs guidance processing for documentation while applying supplemental instructions and excluding generated or third-party directories.

features.name: gw:act
features.description: Runs an explicit Ghostwriter act across a selected path. The gw.act value may name a reusable act, combine an act name with additional prompt text, or contain a prompt-only request beginning with the greater-than character. Aggregator execution processes submodules before parents when it traverses a project tree.

examples.description: Runs the reusable review act over the Java production sources.
Runs a direct prompt-only action, identified by the leading greater-than character, against Markdown documentation.

features.name: gw:gw-per-module
features.description: Runs guidance processing once for each Maven reactor module. Maven controls module ordering using its standard dependency graph; this non-aggregating goal requires a Maven project.

examples.description: Processes guidance within the site directory of every selected reactor module.

features.name: gw:act-per-module
features.description: Runs an explicit Ghostwriter act in the current Maven reactor module rather than recursively traversing the reactor itself.

examples.description: Applies the named review act independently to the Java source directory of each selected reactor module.

features.name: findClass
features.description: Finds fully qualified class names whose simple names match a regular expression in the registered Maven project's visible classpath. The classpath scan includes compile dependencies and output directories; callers should refine searches that yield more than ten matches.

examples.description: Finds Maven mojo classes before selecting one fully qualified name for detailed reflective inspection.

features.name: getClassInfo
features.signature: public java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object> org.machanism.machai.gw.maven.tools.ClassFunctionalTools.getClassInfo(java.lang.String className, java.io.File projectDir) throws java.lang.ClassNotFoundException
features.description: Loads a fully qualified class through the registered Maven project class loader and returns reflective metadata. The result can include modifiers, direct superclass and interfaces, non-private fields and methods, all constructors, annotations, source path, classpath location, and dependency artifact coordinates.

examples.description: Retrieves API and origin metadata for the fully qualified aggregator guidance mojo class.

customizations.name: Maven goal properties
customizations.description: Configure workflows with gw.model, gw.path, gw.instructions, gw.excludes, genai.serverId, gw.config, gw.act, and gw.acts. A Maven settings.xml server selected by genai.serverId can provide username, password, and provider-specific configuration values.

examples.description: Selects credentials from a Maven server entry, chooses a model, and runs a named action over production sources.

examples.title: Install, configure, and run guidance processing
steps: Add the plugin under build plugins in the consuming Maven project's pom.xml using groupId org.machanism.machai, artifactId gw-maven-plugin, and version 1.4.0.
Create a Maven settings.xml server entry for the selected GenAI provider and refer to its id with genai.serverId, or configure a Ghostwriter properties file with gw.config.
Place Ghostwriter guidance comments in the files to maintain, then run the gw goal from the project root with an explicit scan path.
Review changes and run the normal project build and tests.

examples.title: Run a reusable documentation review act
steps: Install the plugin in the project's build or invoke its fully qualified Maven coordinate.
Make a reusable act named review available through the configured acts location, or select an existing act.
Run the act against the desired directory and inspect the resulting edits.
Use the per-module goal instead when Maven should schedule each module through the reactor.
